programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: Gridlocked
programme.desc: Former NYPD SWAT leader David Hendrix (Dominic Purcell) has failed to receive medical clearance after taking a bullet on the job. As if things couldn’t get any worse, he’s forced to babysit Brody Walker (Cody Hackman), a hard partying celebrity that’s been sent on a mandatory ride-along as part of his probation. But all of that changes when a police training facility comes under attack by a team of ruthless mercenaries led by the mysterious Korver (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: A Clear Shot
programme.desc: A hostage situation at an electronic store in California goes a wry when bullets start flying. Will law enforcement be able to come in and save the day or will the hostage takers win.

programme.title: Axis
programme.desc: While driving through Los Angeles over a tense afternoon in real time, an Irish movie star with a rocky past confronts a series of devastating events that threaten his newfound sobriety, his loved ones, and potentially, his life.

programme.title: Everything is Both
programme.desc: This thriller follows a girl who runs for her life and depends on a mysterious stranger to escape danger and pull off the biggest score of her life.

programme.title: Skin In The Game
programme.desc: Abducted off the sidewalk of suburban America, fifteen year old Dani (Sammi Hanratty) finds herself submerged in a horrific human trafficking ring run by Eve (Angélica Celaya). With no initial assistance from the police, Dani's mother (Elisabeth Harnois) and an ex-prostitute (Erica Ash) take to the streets in an effort to find her before it is too late. First time director Adisa takes viewers on an intense journey of a horrific underground world and introduces us to characters from both sides of the street, some who survive … and others who are not so lucky.

programme.title: The Next 8 Seconds
programme.desc: Neil talks about his journey from childhood struggles to a college graduate turned professional bull rider. Facing adversity, racial discrimination as well as countless life and death experiences in the sport of bull riding, Neil has becomes one of the best professional Bull Riders in a sport traditionally known for white bull riders. After 12 years in the sport deemed 'the most dangerous sport on dirt', Neil has decided to hang up his rope to pursue other opportunities. Neil is set to retire in front of his home crowd at Rodeo Houston where he will once again thrill the crowd for 'The Next 8 Seconds'
